meta.title: Epistemic network: GPT axioms, models, state properties, observable effects, and tasks

edge_kinds.implies: source implies target (theorem direction stated in 'statement')
edge_kinds.necessary: source is necessary for target (target implies source)
edge_kinds.not_implies: counterexample: source does not imply target
edge_kinds.enables: source is the resource powering target task/protocol
edge_kinds.open: open problem or conjecture occupying this edge

nodes.label: No-signalling
nodes.def: Marginal statistics of one party independent of the other party's setting.

nodes.label: Local tomography
nodes.def: Composite states determined by local measurement statistics.

nodes.label: Purification
nodes.def: Every mixed state is the marginal of a pure state, unique up to local reversible transformations (Chiribella-D'Ariano-Perinotti).

nodes.label: No-restriction hypothesis
nodes.def: All mathematically well-defined effects (dual cone) are physical measurements.

nodes.label: Information causality
nodes.def: m classical bits assisted by correlations transmit at most m bits of accessible information.

nodes.label: Macroscopic locality
nodes.def: Coarse-grained correlations of many-particle experiments are classical.

nodes.label: Local orthogonality / exclusivity
nodes.def: Sum of probabilities of pairwise exclusive events is at most 1 (Specker / E-principle).

nodes.label: No higher-order interference
nodes.def: Sorkin hierarchy truncates at second order (pairwise slit interference only).

nodes.label: Decoherence to classical
nodes.def: The theory contains a decoherence map onto a classical (simplicial) subtheory.

nodes.label: Classical probability (simplex)
nodes.def: State space a simplex; effect cone its dual; unique noncontextual, local, positive theory.

nodes.label: Quantum theory (complex)
nodes.def: Density operators on complex Hilbert space; all POVMs; CP dynamics.

nodes.label: Real-amplitude QM
nodes.def: Quantum theory over real Hilbert spaces with real tensor-product composites.

nodes.label: Boxworld (GNST)
nodes.def: Maximal no-signalling theory: square state spaces, PR boxes.

nodes.label: Spekkens toy / epistricted theories
nodes.def: Classical ontic states + epistemic restriction (knowledge balance); convexified it is a nonsimplicial but simplex-embeddable GPT.

nodes.label: Odd-d stabilizer subtheory
nodes.def: Stabilizer states/Clifford/Pauli measurements, odd local dimension.

nodes.label: Qubit (even-d) stabilizer subtheory
nodes.def: Stabilizer states/Clifford/Pauli measurements on qubits.

nodes.label: Gaussian quantum mechanics
nodes.def: Gaussian states, Gaussian unitaries, quadrature (homodyne) measurements.

nodes.label: Separable quantum theory (min-tensor QM)
nodes.def: Single systems fully quantum; composite state cone = separable cone (minimal tensor product).

nodes.label: Almost-quantum correlation set
nodes.def: Correlation set Q(1+AB), slightly larger than quantum, satisfying most device-independent principles.

nodes.label: Entanglement
nodes.def: State outside the minimal (separable) cone of a composite.

nodes.label: Bound (PPT) entanglement
nodes.def: Entangled but undistillable; positive partial transpose.

nodes.label: Wigner negativity
nodes.def: Negativity of the (discrete or CV) Wigner function.

nodes.label: Magic (non-stabilizerness)
nodes.def: State outside the stabilizer polytope; resource for state injection.

nodes.label: Coherence / superposition
nodes.def: Off-diagonal structure relative to a basis; GPT-level: strong incompatibility (superposition).

nodes.label: Discord
nodes.def: Nonclassical correlations beyond entanglement.

nodes.label: Athermality
nodes.def: Deviation from the thermal (Gibbs) state; resource under thermal operations.

nodes.label: Asymmetry (unspeakable coherence)
nodes.def: Noninvariance under a symmetry group; coherence across conserved-quantity eigenspaces.

nodes.label: psi-epistemic status
nodes.def: Ontological-model property: distinct quantum states with overlapping ontic distributions.

nodes.label: Bell inequality violation
nodes.def: No local-hidden-variable model for space-like separated statistics.

nodes.label: EPR steering
nodes.def: No local-hidden-state model for an assemblage.

nodes.label: Measurement incompatibility
nodes.def: No joint measurement reproducing the marginals.

nodes.label: KS contextuality (state-independent)
nodes.def: No outcome-deterministic noncontextual value assignment to projective measurements.

nodes.label: State-dependent KS contextuality
nodes.def: Violation of a KS-type noncontextuality inequality by a specific state (e.g. KCBS).

nodes.label: Generalized (Spekkens) contextuality
nodes.def: No generalized-noncontextual ontological model; GPT form: failure of simplex embeddability.

nodes.label: No-cloning / no-broadcasting
nodes.def: Impossibility of a map broadcasting all states.

nodes.label: Second-order interference
nodes.def: Two-path interference phenomenology (fringes, Elitzur-Vaidman, delayed choice).

nodes.label: Higher-order interference
nodes.def: Nonzero Sorkin third-or-higher-order interference terms.

nodes.label: Anomalous weak values
nodes.def: Weak values outside the eigenvalue range.

nodes.label: Kirkwood-Dirac nonpositivity
nodes.def: Negativity or imaginarity of the KD quasiprobability of an experiment.

nodes.label: Anomalous work / heat flows
nodes.def: Work or heat statistics impossible for noncontextual / classically correlated processes.

nodes.label: Superquantum (PR) correlations
nodes.def: No-signalling correlations beyond the Tsirelson bound.

nodes.label: DI randomness & QKD
nodes.def: Device-independent certification from Bell violation.

nodes.label: One-sided DI QKD
nodes.def: Security from steering with one untrusted party.

nodes.label: BB84 key distribution
nodes.def: Prepare-measure key distribution.

nodes.label: Parity-oblivious multiplexing / RAC
nodes.def: Communication games bounded by preparation noncontextuality.

nodes.label: Universal QC (state injection / MBQC)
nodes.def: Promoting free (stabilizer / Clifford) operations to universality.

nodes.label: State-discrimination advantage
nodes.def: Minimum-error discrimination beyond noncontextual bounds.

nodes.label: Postselected metrology
nodes.def: Fisher-information advantages from quasiprobability negativity.

nodes.label: Entanglement witnessing / separability problem
nodes.def: Detecting entanglement; complexity of deciding separability.

nodes.label: Deciding the quantum set
nodes.def: Complexity/decidability of membership in quantum correlations.

nodes.label: Second laws / work extraction
nodes.def: State conversion under thermal operations; work from coherence and correlations.

edges.statement: Incompatible measurements exist iff the state space is not a simplex: all measurements of a GPT are compatible iff the theory is classical.
Generalized no-broadcasting: a GPT admits universal broadcasting iff it is classical; every nonclassical GPT has no-cloning.
Entangleability of cones: min and max tensor products of two GPT cones coincide iff one is classical; any two nonclassical GPT systems can be entangled.
refs: Aubrun, Lami, Palazuelos, Plavala, Geom. Funct. Anal. 31, 181 (2021); arXiv:1911.09663

edges.statement: For any two GPTs: (i) each is nonclassical, (ii) each has strong incompatibility ('superposition'), (iii) the pair is entangleable (entangled states or entangled measurements) - all equivalent. Superposition also suffices to run BB84.
refs: Aubrun, Lami, Palazuelos, Plavala, PRL 128, 160402 (2022); arXiv:2109.04446

edges.statement: A prepare-measure GPT fragment admits a generalized-noncontextual ontological model iff it is simplex-embeddable (state space embeds in a simplex, effects in its dual).
refs: Schmid, Selby, Wolfe, Kunjwal, Spekkens, PRX Quantum 2, 010331 (2021)

edges.statement: Generalized noncontextuality is equivalent to the existence of a nonnegative quasiprobability representation; contextuality = negativity in every such representation.

DERIVED COROLLARY (this work): if any tomographically complete fragment of a GPT system is contextual, the system's cone is nonsimplicial (A5), hence by entangleability of cones (A3) every composite with another nonclassical system supports entangled states (unless the theory postulates the minimal tensor product). Converse fails: Spekkens' toy theory is nonsimplicial (entangleable) yet noncontextual.
refs: Derived from PRX Quantum 2, 010331 (2021) + GAFA 31, 181 (2021); cf. m-sepqt for the min-tensor escape

edges.statement: Contextuality is a precondition for entanglement: entanglement in a nonlocal scenario can arise only if the sequential scenario obtained by remote state preparation exhibits preparation-and-measurement contextuality; robust absence of entanglement implies absence of contextuality. Noncontextuality inequalities map to entanglement witnesses and vice versa.
No-broadcasting characterizes operational contextuality (broadcastability of a fragment corresponds to the existence of a noncontextual model).

Incompatibility is neither necessary nor sufficient for generalized contextuality: epistricted theories have incompatible measurements yet are noncontextual, and every quantum contextuality proof can be converted to one using only compatible measurements (even a single CV projective measurement suffices).
refs: Selby, Schmid, Wolfe, Sainz, Kunjwal, Spekkens, PRL 130, 230201 (2023); arXiv:2106.09045

edges.statement: Conditional equivalence: when ALL quantum states are available as preparations, measurement incompatibility (equivalently steerability) is necessary and sufficient for operational contextuality.
Strict hierarchy: Bell nonlocality implies steerability implies entanglement, with strict inclusions at each level (Werner states witness strictness).
Steering implies entanglement (LHS models exist for all separable states); inclusion strict.
Gisin's theorem: every PURE bipartite (and multipartite) entangled state violates some Bell inequality. Fails for mixed states.
Werner states: entangled mixed states admitting local hidden variable models for all projective measurements, and even for all POVMs.
In the measurement-device-independent (semiquantum game) scenario every entangled state outperforms separable ones: 'all entangled states are nonlocal' with quantum inputs.
Activation: local filtering reveals hidden nonlocality (even genuinely, for states with LHV models for the filtered statistics), and nonlocality can be superactivated by taking many copies.
One-to-one map: a measurement assemblage is steerable iff the steering party's measurements are incompatible (quantum theory); joint measurability implies an LHS model and vice versa.

Compatible measurements never violate any Bell inequality (Fine); any incompatible PAIR of dichotomic measurements violates CHSH with a suitable state and partner; but general incompatible SETS need not enable any Bell violation.
OPEN (since 1998): do NPT bound entangled states exist (is PPT necessary for undistillability)? PPT implies undistillable is a theorem.
Peres conjecture is FALSE: there exist PPT (bound) entangled states violating a Bell inequality; bound entanglement can also be steerable.
A state is entangled iff some entanglement witness detects it (Hahn-Banach); yet deciding separability is NP-hard, so no efficient universal witness exists.

The quantum correlation set is not closed, and approximating the quantum value of a nonlocal game is undecidable (MIP* = RE); Tsirelson's problem and Connes' embedding conjecture resolved in the negative.
refs: Ji, Natarajan, Vidick, Wright, Yuen, arXiv:2001.04383; CACM 64(11), 131 (2021)

edges.statement: Bell violation certifies randomness expansion and device-independent QKD.
Steering certifies one-sided device-independent QKD.
refs: Branciard, Cavalcanti, Walborn, Scarani, Wiseman, PRA 85, 010301(R) (2012)

edges.statement: For multiqubit systems, every logical KS proof requires entangled measurements and every statistical KS proof requires an entangled state; not every entangled state yields one.
Structural bridges: invertible map between Bell-nonlocality and contextuality scenarios; contextuality can be converted into nonlocality; graph-theoretic (CSW) bounds unify both.
Monogamy between contextuality and nonlocality: in combined scenarios the two resources trade off (no-disturbance monogamy).
Odd prime dimension: a qudit state enables violation of a noncontextuality inequality with stabilizer measurements iff its discrete Wigner function is negative ('contextuality supplies the magic').
Continuous variables: contextuality and Wigner negativity are equivalent with respect to CV Pauli (quadrature-displacement) measurements - CV analogue of Howard et al.
Nonnegative Wigner functions (odd d; CV) admit efficient classical simulation of the circuit, so Wigner negativity is necessary for quantum speedup in these settings.
Magic states are the resource promoting fault-tolerant stabilizer operations to universality; quantified by the resource theory of stabilizer computation.

The odd-d stabilizer subtheory has a UNIQUE nonnegative diagram-preserving quasiprobability representation - Gross's Wigner function, equivalent to Spekkens' epistricted toy theory - hence it is noncontextual, with a singled-out classical model.

In all even dimensions no nonnegative diagram-preserving quasiprobability representation of the stabilizer subtheory exists: the qubit stabilizer subtheory is generalized-contextual (and state-independently KS-contextual via the Mermin square).

Generalized contextuality is a necessary resource for universal quantum computation in the state-injection model (odd d via uniqueness of the Gross representation; qubits via even-d contextuality); KS-contextuality similarly powers MBQC and shallow-circuit advantage.

CAVEAT: a nonnegative probabilistic hidden-variable model (Bayesian updates on a finite state space) covers universal quantum computation with magic states for qubits and all qudit dimensions. It is not diagram-preserving, so it evades the noncontextuality no-gos - negativity is representation-relative; generalized contextuality is the invariant statement.

KD nonpositivity of suitable experiments implies negativity of every quasiprobability representation, hence contextuality; anomalous weak values are its operational face. Caution: not every KD-negative assignment certifies contextuality once general KD representations are allowed.
refs: Arvidsson-Shukur et al. (KD review), NJP 2024; arXiv:2403.18899
Schmid, Baldijao, Ying, Wagner, Selby, arXiv:2405.04573

edges.statement: Anomalous weak values are proofs of generalized contextuality.
KD negativity underlies anomalous postselected Fisher information (metrology beyond classical limits); recently argued necessary for quantum-computational advantage.
Preparation contextuality powers parity-oblivious multiplexing (the optimal quantum advantage is a preparation-noncontextuality violation).
refs: Spekkens, Buzacott, Keehn, Toner, Pryde, PRL 102, 010401 (2009)

edges.statement: Contextual advantage for minimum-error state discrimination.

Every KS proof converts to a state-dependent noncontextuality inequality violated by every state (statistical form); state-dependent KS contextuality exists from d=3 (KCBS) and requires a non-chordal compatibility graph.

Within quantum theory, coherence converts faithfully to entanglement by incoherent operations plus an incoherent ancilla (entanglement generated is bounded by input coherence); coherence likewise activates discord.
refs: Streltsov, Singh, Dhar, Bera, Adesso, PRL 115, 020403 (2015)
Ma, Yadin, Girolami, Vedral, Gu, PRL 116, 160407 (2016)

edges.statement: PROPOSITION (folklore, proof in catalog): a prepare-measure fragment whose states and effects are all diagonal in one basis is simplex-embeddable, hence noncontextual; so every contextuality proof needs basis-independent coherence of the state set. Quantitative witnesses exist in interferometric scenarios (event-graph / MZI inequalities).

Coherence does NOT suffice for contextuality: epistricted theories (Spekkens toy, Gaussian, odd-d stabilizer) display superposition-like structure and full two-path interference phenomenology (double slit, Elitzur-Vaidman, delayed choice, quantum eraser) while remaining noncontextual. Only specific further aspects of interference are genuinely nonclassical.
refs: Catani, Leifer, Scala, Schmid, Spekkens, PRA 2023 (genuinely nonclassical interference)

edges.statement: No coherence threshold: contextuality proofs exist with maximal robustness to dephasing, i.e. arbitrarily small (vanishing) coherence still witnesses contextuality - coherence is necessary but its magnitude is not the resource.
refs: Rossi, Schmid, Selby, Sainz, PRA 2023; arXiv:2212.06856

edges.statement: Unspeakable coherence = asymmetry relative to the group generated by a conserved quantity; Noether-type conservation fails for open covariant dynamics and asymmetry monotones take its place.

Real-amplitude quantum theory (with real tensor composites) reproduces single-site statistics but fails in quantum networks: a three-party entanglement-swapping Bell test separates complex from real QM, and experiments violate the real-QM bound. Imaginarity is a genuine resource.
No-signalling alone does not forbid superquantum correlations: PR boxes reach CHSH = 4.
Information causality implies the Tsirelson bound (CHSH <= 2 sqrt 2); whether it carves out exactly the quantum set is OPEN.
refs: Pawlowski, Paterek, Kaszlikowski, Scarani, Winter, Zukowski, Nature 461, 1101 (2009)

edges.statement: Macroscopic locality bounds correlations to the (strictly larger than quantum) NPA level Q1.
refs: Navascues, Wunderlich, Proc. R. Soc. A 466, 881 (2010)

edges.statement: Local orthogonality / exclusivity rules out PR boxes and reproduces the quantum (Lovasz-theta) bound of the KCBS contextuality inequality.
refs: Fritz, Sainz, Augusiak, Brask, Chaves, Leverrier, Acin, Nat. Commun. 4, 2263 (2013)

edges.statement: Almost-quantum correlations satisfy the main device-independent principles yet strictly exceed quantum; NO GPT satisfying the no-restriction hypothesis reproduces them - a restriction on measurements is forced.
refs: Navascues, Guryanova, Hoban, Acin, Nat. Commun. 6, 6288 (2015)

edges.statement: Purification forces entanglement (purifications of mixed states are entangled) and yields no-cloning, steering of ensembles, probabilistic teleportation, reversible dilation and no-information-without-disturbance; with five further informational axioms it singles out quantum theory.
Boxworld attains maximal no-signalling nonlocality (PR boxes) but all its reversible dynamics are trivial (local operations + permutations): no entanglement swapping, no dynamics-based teleportation.
Locally quantum systems + no-signalling composition force bipartite correlations into the quantum set (Tsirelson bound emerges from local structure alone).
refs: Barnum, Beigi, Boixo, Elliott, Wehner, PRL 104, 140401 (2010)

edges.statement: Quantum theory has exactly second-order interference (Sorkin hierarchy truncates); experiments bound third-order terms; higher-order interference is excluded by purity principles in GPTs, while 'density cube' theories realize it.
Any nonclassical GPT containing a decoherence mechanism onto classical theory must contain entangled states: entanglement is necessary for emergent classicality.

PBR: preparation-independent psi-epistemic models contradict quantum statistics; maximally psi-epistemic models fail for d>=3 independently of preparation independence; psi-epistemic models without these assumptions do exist.

Spekkens' toy theory reproduces incompatibility, no-cloning, interference, teleportation and dense-coding analogues AND ensemble steering - yet is local, noncontextual and nonnegative: steering phenomenology alone does not certify contextuality or nonlocality.

Gaussian QM: two-mode squeezed states are EPR-steerable with quadrature measurements, yet the positive Wigner function provides an LHV model for all Gaussian measurements (no Bell violation without non-Gaussian measurements), and the whole subtheory embeds in an epistricted classical theory (noncontextual).

OBSERVATION (this work): separable quantum theory (quantum marginals, minimal tensor product) retains Wigner negativity, magic and generalized contextuality of single systems while possessing NO entangled states, NO steering and NO Bell violation; purification fails. This is the unique escape route from the derived corollary 'contextuality implies entangleability' - and it pins the burden of forcing entanglement on the composition axiom (purification / beyond-min tensor product).
refs: Construction standard: min/max tensor products, e.g. Janotta, Hinrichsen, J. Phys. A 47, 323001 (2014)

edges.statement: Boxworld violates information causality, macroscopic locality and local orthogonality (PR boxes trivialize communication complexity).
Real-amplitude QM violates local tomography (composite real systems are not determined by local statistics).
refs: Wootters, in 'Complexity, Entropy and the Physics of Information' (1990)

edges.statement: Second laws: under thermal operations, state conversion of (block-)diagonal states is governed by the full family of alpha-Renyi free energies, not the single free energy.
refs: Brandao, Horodecki, Oppenheim, Renes, Spekkens, PNAS 112, 3275 (2015)

edges.statement: Coherence is an independent thermodynamic resource: time-translation covariance of thermal operations forbids coherence creation and forces coherence monotones (asymmetry measures) to decay - constraints beyond all free-energy second laws.
Work-locking: the coherent part of the free energy of an individual system is not extractable as work without a phase reference (it unlocks collectively or with an ancillary reference).

Any fluctuation theorem reproducing the two-point-measurement statistics on classical states either admits a work quasiprobability or fails on contextual protocols; negativity of the work quasiprobability is a direct signature of contextuality. Noncontextual bounds exist on average work and heat in sequential-measurement protocols; anomalous heat flow witnesses contextuality.
refs: Contextuality in anomalous heat flow, arXiv:2406.09715 (2024)

edges.statement: Initial quantum correlations can reverse the thermodynamic arrow (heat flows from cold to hot), observed experimentally with NMR spins; KD work distributions reconstructed interferometrically.
refs: Hernandez-Gomez et al., npj Quantum Inf. 10 (2024)

edges.statement: GPT thermodynamics: in sharp theories with purification, the three microcanonical resource theories (RaRe / noisy / unital) are well-posed, state conversion is majorization-governed, and purity resources are DUAL to pure-state entanglement resources - the entanglement-thermodynamics duality generalizes beyond quantum theory.
A bipartite state is locally broadcastable iff it has zero discord (classically correlated): no-local-broadcasting characterizes quantum correlations beyond entanglement.
refs: Ferraro et al., PRA 81, 052318 (2010) (discordant states are generic)

edges.statement: GPT-level: strong incompatibility ('superposition') in each local theory suffices to run the BB84 key-distribution protocol - key distribution survives even if quantum theory is replaced.
Measurement incompatibility is the exact resource for quantum advantage in random access codes.
Contextuality quantifies one-shot classical communication advantage with entanglement assistance.

OPEN: no known set of device-independent principles (IC, ML, LO, NANLC...) singles out the quantum correlation set; the almost-quantum set satisfies them (IC unresolved) and obstructs the program; its own GPT status requires violating no-restriction.

GAP: no quantitative resource translation coherence -> contextuality is known. Wanted: minimal extra structure (tomographic completeness of mutually unbiased fragments? saturated uncertainty relations?) under which a coherence monotone lower-bounds a contextuality robustness. Partial: event-graph witnesses; uncertainty-relation nonclassicality; genuinely nonclassical interference aspects.

GAP (even dimensions): no clean iff between qubit magic and a contextuality/negativity measure; state-independent Pauli contextuality and the Zurel-Okay-Raussendorf model obstruct naive formulations. Known: generalized contextuality is necessary for qubit state injection; cost functions over the Lambda-polytope partially quantify it.
refs: Raussendorf, Browne, Delfosse, Okay, Bermejo-Vega, PRA 95, 052334 (2017)

edges.statement: GAP: no GPT-level characterization of which composites exhibit steering (the steering analogue of entangleability of cones). Known: purification implies steering; steering implies incompatibility in broad tensor-product classes; restricted operational theories connect steering to contextuality. Conjecture (this work): every beyond-min composite of nonclassical tomographically-complete GPTs with at least one pure entangled state is steerable.
refs: Plavala et al., Incompatibility in restricted operational theories, arXiv (2024)

edges.statement: GAP: is every contextual process detectable by SOME thermodynamic anomaly (work/heat/entropy-production statistics)? Partial: work-quasiprobability negativity, noncontextual bounds on heat, anomalous heat flow witnesses. Wanted: completeness theorem for thermodynamic contextuality witnesses within thermal operations.
GAP: relation between higher-order (Sorkin) interference and contextuality/negativity measures is uncharted; the contextuality status of density-cube theories is unknown.

GAP: which thermodynamic requirements (well-posed microcanonics, second laws, Landauer) FORCE purification-like axioms? Partial results for sharp theories with purification and for spectrality+strong symmetry; the converse direction is open.

GAP: a general monogamy/trade-off theory between single-system contextuality and composite nonlocality (beyond specific no-disturbance scenarios) is missing; the Wright-Farkas scenario map suggests a unified resource calculus is possible.
GAP: thermodynamic signature of bound entanglement (work-extraction gap between bound and separable states under LOCC-thermal constraints) is not characterized.
refs: cf. Oppenheim, Horodecki x3, PRL 89, 180402 (2002) (thermodynamic approach to correlations)

edges.statement: Witness infrastructure: failures of noncontextuality are testable by linear programming on accessible GPT fragments, robustly to noise, without incompatibility, without ideal detectors, and (with care) without exact tomographic completeness - 'shadows and subsystems' close the tomographic-incompleteness loophole.
refs: Selby, Wolfe, Schmid, Sainz, Rossi, arXiv:2204.11905
Mazurek et al., Nat. Commun. 7, ncomms11780 (2016)
